..Title
Resolution to Approve a Professional Services Agreement with Henry Ford Health System d/b/a Henry Ford Health for On-Site Occupational Medical Surveillance Services ($90,000.00)
..Memorandum
The attached resolution requests authorization for a three-year contract for services with Henry Ford Health System d/b/a Henry Ford Health ("Henry Ford Health"), not to exceed $30,000.00 per year, starting in January of 2023. In addition, the resolution seeks authorization for administrative approval of two (2) two-year renewal terms pursuant to the same terms and conditions.

Since 2017, Henry Ford Health has provided the City with on-site occupational medical surveillance testing services including annual audiograms, respirator user clearance and fit testing, tuberculosis testing and other services as required by Michigan Occupational Safety and Health regulations.

Budget/Fiscal Impact:  Funds for this contract will be included in the FY23 Safety Unit budget.  

Henry Ford Health complies with the requirements of the Non-Discrimination, Conflict of Interest, and Living Wage ordinances.
..Staff
Prepared by:  Doug Forsyth, Safety Manager
Reviewed by:  Michelle Landis, Senior Assistant City Attorney
Approved by:  Milton Dohoney Jr., City Administrator
..Body
Whereas, In 2022, the City Safety Unit issued a request for proposal for qualified vendors and provided intent to award to Henry Ford Health pending City Council approval;

Whereas, Henry Ford Health has met the obligations of their previous contract successfully to date; and

Whereas, Henry Ford Health has enabled the City to meet it's legal and moral obligations to provide occupational testing and screening services to its employees in compliance with occupational health regulations;

RESOLVED, That Council approve a three-year contract with Henry Ford Health not to exceed $30,000.00 per year to perform on-site occupational medical surveillance services;

RESOLVED, That the Mayor and City Clerk be authorized and directed to execute the agreement after approval as to substance by the City Administrator and approval as to form by the City Attorney; and

RESOLVED, That the City Administrator be authorized to take all necessary actions to implement this resolution including execution of any documentation to identify Henry Ford Health as the City's provider for on-site occupational medical surveillance services, and any changes or amendments that do not exceed the amounts authorized herein.

RESOLVED, That the City Administrator be authorized to approve two (2) two-year renewal terms under the same terms and conditions, at the City's discretion.
